scheme_name: CGTMSE (Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises)
target_segment: Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs) without collateral
loan_ceiling: ₹10 crore guarantee cover per borrower (raised from ₹5 crore, w.e.f. 01.04.2025; ₹200 lakh for SFBs/RRBs/urban co-op banks, ₹50 lakh for MFIs)

checks.label: Guarantee covers collateral-free MSME loans
checks.basis: collateral_requirement: None — the guarantee covers 85% of the loan up to Rs 15 lakh

checks.label: Udyam registration is recommended to prove MSE status
checks.basis: eligibility_rules: Udyam registration recommended (not strictly mandatory)

collateral_requirement: None — the guarantee covers 85% of the loan for micro loans up to ₹5 lakh and 75% above
one_line_eligibility: New and existing MSEs borrowing from a member lending institution (bank/SFB/RRB/NBFC); Udyam registration recommended.
eligibility_rules: Business must qualify as a Micro or Small Enterprise under the MSME definition
Loan sanctioned by a Member Lending Institution (PSB, private/foreign bank, SFB, RRB, urban co-op bank or eligible NBFC/MFI)
Both new and existing enterprises are eligible
Udyam registration recommended (not strictly mandatory) to validate MSE status
exclusions: Loans fully backed by tangible collateral, cash or a third-party guarantee are not guaranteed (hybrid security is treated partially)
Only loans covered under the current CGTMSE operational guidelines qualify
documents: Business proof (shop agreement, licence or unit address)
interest_rate: Decided by the lending bank — the scheme guarantees the loan, it does not set the rate
apply_via: Any CGTMSE member lending institution (nearest bank branch)

scheme_name: MUDRA (Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency Ltd.) - Shishu
benefit_type: Collateral-free loan for new micro units

checks.label: Crop cultivation is not covered by this scheme
Allied agriculture (dairy, poultry, beekeeping) is covered
checks.basis: eligibility_rules: activities allied to agriculture such as poultry, dairy, beekeeping

checks.label: For individuals, proprietorships and partnerships (not companies)
checks.basis: eligibility_rules: Available to individuals, proprietorship concerns, partnership firms

nodal_agency: Banks, NBFCs, MFIs (Member Lending Institutions under MUDRA/SIDBI)
one_line_eligibility: Any non-corporate, non-farm micro-individual or small unit — including women, proprietorships, partnerships and firms.
eligibility_rules: Income-generating activity in manufacturing, trading or services sector (including activities allied to agriculture such as poultry, dairy, beekeeping)
Available to individuals, proprietorship concerns, partnership firms and other eligible entities
Non-corporate and non-farm (fanning/crop cultivation not covered)
No collateral and no guarantor needed
exclusions: Large enterprises above the micro-enterprise definition
apply_via: Any bank branch, NBFC or MFI; online via mudra.org.in partners

scheme_name: MUDRA (Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency Ltd.) - Kishore
benefit_type: Collateral-free expansion loan for existing micro units
target_segment: Micro-entrepreneurs who have started and want to expand

checks.label: Crop cultivation is not covered by this scheme
Allied agriculture (dairy, poultry, beekeeping) is covered
checks.basis: eligibility_rules: activities allied to agriculture such as poultry, dairy, beekeeping

nodal_agency: Banks, NBFCs, MFIs (Member Lending Institutions under MUDRA/SIDBI)
one_line_eligibility: Existing micro units seeking expansion funding — stock, equipment or working capital.
eligibility_rules: Existing or new income-generating micro unit in manufacturing, trading or services
Available to individuals, proprietorships, partnerships and firms
Higher tranches suit businesses already showing steady income
No collateral and no guarantor needed
apply_via: Any bank branch, NBFC or MFI

scheme_name: MUDRA (Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency Ltd.) - Tarun
benefit_type: Collateral-free growth loan for established micro units

checks.label: Crop cultivation is not covered by this scheme
Allied agriculture (dairy, poultry, beekeeping) is covered
checks.basis: eligibility_rules: activities allied to agriculture such as poultry, dairy, beekeeping

nodal_agency: Banks, NBFCs, MFIs (Member Lending Institutions under MUDRA/SIDBI)
one_line_eligibility: Growth-stage micro units needing a larger loan for equipment, stock or expansion.
eligibility_rules: Micro enterprise in manufacturing, trading or services with a track record
Available to individuals, proprietorships, partnerships and firms
Banks assess the repayment track record before sanctioning this tranche
No collateral and no guarantor needed under PMMY
apply_via: Any bank branch, NBFC or MFI

scheme_name: MUDRA (Micro Units Development & Refinance Agency Ltd.) - Tarun Plus
benefit_type: Collateral-free larger loan for Tarun graduates
target_segment: Micro-enterprises that repaid a Tarun loan

checks.label: Crop cultivation is not covered by this scheme
Allied agriculture (dairy, poultry, beekeeping) is covered
checks.basis: eligibility_rules: activities allied to agriculture such as poultry, dairy, beekeeping

collateral_requirement: None (PMMY loans are collateral-free up to ₹20 lakh)
nodal_agency: Banks, NBFCs, MFIs (Member Lending Institutions under MUDRA/SIDBI)
one_line_eligibility: Entrepreneurs who have availed and successfully repaid a loan under the Tarun category.
eligibility_rules: Must have availed and successfully repaid a loan under the MUDRA Tarun category
Introduces the next stage of growth after Tarun (added in Union Budget 2024-25)
Loans up to ₹20 lakh extended collateral-free by Member Lending Institutions
exclusions: Borrowers without a successfully repaid Tarun loan
documents: Repayment track record for the earlier Tarun loan
apply_via: Any bank branch, NBFC or MFI

benefit_type: New micro-enterprise loan with margin money subsidy
target_segment: New micro enterprises in the non-farm sector (manufacturing/services)

checks.label: Crop cultivation is outside PMEGP (non-farm sector only)
checks.basis: exclusions: Activities in the negative list / eligibility_rules: non-farm

checks.label: Manufacturing or service sector micro unit
checks.basis: eligibility_rules: New micro-enterprise in manufacturing or business/service sector (non-farm)

checks.label: One unit per family — a second unit needs the first loan repaid
checks.basis: exclusions: Units already financed under PMEGP / REGP / MUDRA in the same family

checks.label: Margin money subsidy is higher (25-35%) for rural units than urban (15-25%)
checks.basis: eligibility_rules: Margin money subsidy 25-35% rural, 15-25% urban

collateral_requirement: None for loans up to ₹10 lakh (CGTMSE-backed); beyond that banks may ask for security
nodal_agency: KVIC (Khadi and Village Industries Commission) with banks
one_line_eligibility: Any individual above 18 years setting up a new project/micro enterprise; at least VIII standard pass for projects above ₹10 lakh (Mfg) / ₹5 lakh (Service).
eligibility_rules: Indian citizen aged 18 years or above
New micro-enterprise in manufacturing or business/service sector (non-farm)
Minimum VIII standard for projects above ₹10 lakh (manufacturing) or ₹5 lakh (service)
Only one unit per family under PMEGP; a second loan is available for units that have successfully repaid
Margin money subsidy 25–35% in rural areas and 15–25% in urban areas (higher for special categories)

Activities in the negative list under PMEGP guidelines

benefit_type: Collateral-free working-capital loan for street vendors
target_segment: Street vendors (informal micro-entrepreneurs) in urban areas
loan_ceiling: ₹15,000 (12 months) first tranche; up to ₹25,000 (18 months) and ₹50,000 (36 months) on timely repayment

checks.label: Only for street vendors — other businesses are not covered

checks.basis: eligibility_rules: Holds a valid vending certificate / ULB identification letter

Holds a valid vending certificate / ULB identification letter

Bank account (PMJDY / Jan Dhan account works)
